mentions.name: Extreme Puzzle Books
mentions.description: A series of hard puzzle books featuring sudoku, killer sudoku, and fiendish wordsearches that use only 5 letters per grid. All logic puzzles include an online step-by-step solution walkthrough, and custom software generates, tests, and verifies the puzzles against difficulty requirements.
